nodes.help: Briefly describe what you want to ask for or the request you may say no to.

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is this person able to give or do what I want?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Can I give the person what is wanted?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is getting my objective more important than my relationship with this person?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Is my relationship more important than saying no?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Will asking help me feel competent and self-respecting?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Will saying no make me feel bad about myself?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is the person required by law or moral code to do or give me what I want?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Am I required by law or moral code to give or do what is wanted, or does saying no violate this person's rights?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Am I responsible for telling the person what to do?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Is the other person responsible for telling me what to do?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is what I want appropriate for this relationship?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Is what the person is requesting appropriate to my relationship with this person?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is asking important to a long-term goal?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: In the long term, will I regret saying no?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Do I give as much as I get with this person?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Do I owe this person a favor?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Do I know what I want and have the facts I need to support my request?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Do I know what I am saying no to?

prompt_by_mode.ask: Is this a good time to ask?
prompt_by_mode.say-no: Should I wait a while before saying no?

nodes.title: Source-backed intensity guidance
nodes.body: For asking, each Yes adds one dime. For saying No, each No adds one dime. More dimes indicate a stronger response.
